resources.name: Especificación GTFS (General Transport Feed Specification) - Sistema Integrado de Transporte Público

metadata.title: GTFS Estáticos 2022-11-23
metadata.snippet: Conjunto de datos relacionados con la operación de la flota implemnetando la especificación GTFS

post.description:
Search the stops and stations of Bogotá's public transport network (TransMilenio, feeders, SITP zonal buses, TransMiCable) by name or code, by the route that serves them (`B10`, `C25`), or near a point (latitude, longitude and radius in metres, nearest first). Each stop carries its location, accessibility, its platforms and every route that stops there. Schedule data refreshed daily.

**Dataset endpoint**: answers from the whole source in milliseconds and carries `as_of`.

query.description: Optional words in the stop's or station's name, or its code, e.g. `Portal Norte`, `Calle 72`, `Héroes`.

route.description: Optional route: its `route_id` (e.g. `10075`) or its public code as printed on the bus (e.g. `B10`, `C25`, `T25`). A code matches every direction of that route.

kind.description: Optional kind: `station` (a TransMilenio or TransMiCable station, which holds platforms) or `stop` (a platform inside a station, or a street stop). Empty returns both.

latitude.description: Optional latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. `4.6486`. With `longitude`, returns only what is within `radius_m` of that point, nearest first.

longitude.description: Optional longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. `-74.0633`. With `latitude`, returns only what is within `radius_m` of that point, nearest first.

radius_m.description: Radius in metres around `latitude` and `longitude` (50-5000). Default `500`.

post.description:
One stop or station of Bogotá's public transport network by its `stop_id`: name, code, location, accessibility, platforms and every route that stops there, plus the station a platform belongs to.

**Dataset endpoint**: answers from the whole source in milliseconds and carries `as_of`.

stop_id.description: The stop's or station's `stop_id`, as the stop search returns it, e.g. `10000` (Portal 20 de Julio). A station covers every platform inside it.

post.description:
The scheduled departures from a stop or station of Bogotá's public transport network, for today or any date, from now or a given time, across every route or one (`B10`): time, route, destination and minutes from now. Weekends and public holidays follow their own timetable, and trips past midnight are included. For buses already on their way, use stop-arrivals.

**Dataset endpoint**: answers from the whole source in milliseconds and carries `as_of`.

stop_id.description: The stop's or station's `stop_id`, as the stop search returns it, e.g. `10000` (Portal 20 de Julio). A station covers every platform inside it.

date.description: Optional day, `yyyy-mm-dd`, in Bogotá. Empty is today. Weekends and public holidays follow their own timetable.

from_time.description: Optional time of day, `HH:MM` in 24-hour Bogotá time, e.g. `07:30`. Empty is now for today and the start of the day for any other date.

route.description: Optional route: its `route_id` (e.g. `10075`) or its public code as printed on the bus (e.g. `B10`, `C25`, `T25`). A code matches every direction of that route.

post.description:
Search the routes of Bogotá's public transport network by code (`B10`, `G43`) or destination, by system (`troncal`, `alimentador`, `dual`, `zonal_urbano`, `zonal_complementario`, `zonal_especial`, `transmicable`), or by a stop they serve. Each route carries its colour, number of stops, trips a week, first and last departures and its timetables.

**Dataset endpoint**: answers from the whole source in milliseconds and carries `as_of`.

query.description: Optional route code or words in its destination, e.g. `B10`, `G43`, `Portal Suba`.

system.description: Optional part of the network: `troncal` (TransMilenio BRT), `alimentador` (feeders), `dual` (routes that run on the busway and the street), `zonal_urbano`, `zonal_complementario`, `zonal_especial` (the SITP street buses) or `transmicable` (the cable car). Empty returns every system.

stop_id.description: Optional `stop_id` of a stop or station, as the stop search returns it. A station covers every platform inside it.

post.description:
One route of Bogotá's public transport network by its `route_id`: its timetables, first and last departures, and every sequence of stops it runs in order, with each stop's location and scheduled minutes from the start. With `include_geometry`, each sequence carries its path as a GeoJSON LineString for a map.

**Dataset endpoint**: answers from the whole source in milliseconds and carries `as_of`.

route_id.description: The route's `route_id`, as the route search returns it, e.g. `10075`. Each direction of a route has its own id.

include_geometry.description: When true, each pattern carries its path as a GeoJSON `LineString`, ready to draw on a map. Default `false`.

post.description: Where the buses and cable cars of Bogotá's public transport network are right now: position, speed, route, trip and the stop each one is at or heading to, updated about every 20 seconds. Filter by route (`B10`) or around a point (latitude, longitude, radius in metres, nearest first).

route.description: Optional route: its `route_id` (e.g. `10075`) or its public code as printed on the bus (e.g. `B10`, `C25`, `T25`). A code matches every direction of that route.

latitude.description: Optional latitude in decimal degrees, e.g. `4.6486`. With `longitude`, returns only what is within `radius_m` of that point, nearest first.

longitude.description: Optional longitude in decimal degrees, e.g. `-74.0633`. With `latitude`, returns only what is within `radius_m` of that point, nearest first.

radius_m.description: Radius in metres around `latitude` and `longitude` (50-5000). Default `500`.

post.description: The vehicles of Bogotá's public transport network about to reach a stop or station, live: route, destination, predicted arrival time, minutes away and delay against the timetable, updated about every 20 seconds. Pair it with stop-departures for the rest of the day's timetable.

stop_id.description: The stop's or station's `stop_id`, as the stop search returns it, e.g. `10000` (Portal 20 de Julio). A station covers every platform inside it.

route.description: Optional route: its `route_id` (e.g. `10075`) or its public code as printed on the bus (e.g. `B10`, `C25`, `T25`). A code matches every direction of that route.

post.description: The service alerts of Bogotá's public transport network in force now: detours, closed stops, reduced service and delays, with their cause, effect, text, active period and the routes and stops affected. Filter by route (`B10`) or stop.

route.description: Optional route: its `route_id` (e.g. `10075`) or its public code as printed on the bus (e.g. `B10`, `C25`, `T25`). A code matches every direction of that route.

stop_id.description: Optional `stop_id` of a stop or station, as the stop search returns it. A station covers every platform inside it.
